annotations.kubernetes.io/limit-ranger: LimitRanger plugin set: cpu, memory request for init container install-psql; memory limit for init container install-psql; cpu, memory request for init container wait-for-db; memory limit for init container wait-for-db

args:
set -e
mkdir -p /opt/pgclient/bin /opt/pgclient/lib
cp -L /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/psql /opt/pgclient/bin/psql
for lib in $(ldd /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/psql | awk '/=>/{print $3}'); do
  cp -L "$lib" /opt/pgclient/lib/ 2>/dev/null || true
done
initContainers.name: install-psql

command: until pg_isready -h verdify-db -p 5432 -U verdify; do echo "waiting for db"; sleep 2; done
initContainers.name: wait-for-db

state.halt_reason: desired fixed candidate changed or completed field reappeared
